prompt:
Analyze the following customer support inquiry. Classify severity into {routine, frustrated, severe}.
Return JSON with 'severity' and 'reason'.

INQUIRY: "@AppleSupport I bought an iPhone and an iPad for my mum on apple store. 12 hours after the order you decided to charge my credit card for the iPad again. I wonder how your billing system even works or when I can get my $529 back."
Output JSON: {"severity": "<routine|frustrated|severe>", "reason": "<one_line_explanation>"}
